quarterly_data.signal: Price increase: Tokai Carbon is raising prices of isotropic graphite and related products by 10% ~ 20%, effective January 1st, 2027. The company cites the recent surge in energy prices, rising logistics costs and the sharp increase in the prices of coke and coal-tar pitch, its primary raw materials, which it says it can no longer absorb through its own efficiency and cost-reduction efforts.
